description:
You arrive in an usual kind of place. That is to say, you're in a kitchen.

You make out a fridge. You make out a closed conventional looking oven close by. You can make out a table. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. You can make out a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you see a red hot pepper, a cookbook and a knife. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You make a mental note to not get your hopes up the next time you see a stove in a room.
